subject: POC prompt dataset collection - next steps
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: POC prompt/logs for eval plan

Thanks again for the demo this morning — it was helpful to see Redwood in action. As discussed on the call, the security team needs a short data collection (prompts + corresponding expected outputs) and any anonymized logs we can share so your team can build an initial eval.

High-level success criteria from our side:
- Latency: median RL latency <= 200ms for typical user prompts
- Quality: classification F1 >= 0.85 on our labeled set; for generation tasks we want precision on entity extraction >= 0.9
- Cost: cost per 1k tokens within the estimates you shared (please confirm)

Can you send a template/format we should use for the prompt set (CSV or JSONL) and the preferred upload method? We can provide a small sample (200-500 prompts) and a representative log extract — we'll sanitize PHI/PII before sharing.

Also looping in Priya (product) — Priya, we plan to hand off datasets by EOD Monday if that timeline still works.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager
AcmeCorp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: POC prompt/logs for eval plan

Hi Alex — great to chat, thanks for the clear success criteria. Short answers up front: yes we can hit the latency target on the dedicated config we discussed (we'll confirm once we run the eval), and cost estimates I sent in the deck are our baseline — I'll include a modeled cost per 1k tokens after we run your sample.

Attached: prompt_samples.csv (template) and data_privacy_notes.pdf (redaction checklist + our shared responsibilities). Template columns: id, prompt, expected_output, task_type, priority (1-3), sensitive (yes/no), source. If you prefer JSONL, we can accept that too — same fields.

Proposed plan and ownership:
- You (Acme): provide prompt set + sanitized logs by 2027-05-10 EOD. Attachments: acme_prompts_v1.csv is fine.
- Redwood: run eval and return metrics by 2027-05-17.
  - Owner (eval run): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
  - Owner (instrumentation/metrics): Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwood.com)
  - Owner (QA & prompt edge-cases): Rachel Kim (rachel_kim@redwood.com)
- Joint demo / review: target 2027-05-20 (30-45m).

Immediate next steps:
1) Please use the attached CSV and confirm when upload is ready.
2) If you have any regulatory constraints on upload (SFTP, VPN), list them and we will route to our security team.
3) If there are labeled subsets that map to your KPIs, please include an accompanying KPIs spreadsheet — that helps us compute the quality targets you care about (attach acmecorp_kpis.xlsx if available).

I'll start the eval harness template once we receive your file; Aditya will instrument token-level latency/cost traces.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: POC prompt/logs for eval plan

Marissa — thanks for the template. Attached is acme_prompts_v1.csv (200 rows) and acmecorp_kpis.xlsx. We removed direct PHI and replaced with tokens per your checklist; data_privacy_notes.pdf looks good.

Quick notes on the sample:
- Mix of classification (50%), extraction (30%), and free-form generation (20%).
- Each row includes a column "source" that maps to product area (search, support-bot, content-gen).
- We've included expected_output for deterministic tasks; for generation tasks we included 3 acceptable variants.

Upload: we put the files on a shared Drive folder for now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1example. If you need SFTP for compliance, let us know and we can arrange.

Timelines: we can confirm the upload window through EOD today. Otherwise Priya and I will be available for any clarifying calls tomorrow.

- Alex

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 08:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Alex — confirming the template and timeline.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: POC prompt/logs for eval plan — receipt & next steps

Alex — got the files and the Drive link, thanks. I downloaded acme_prompts_v1.csv and acmecorp_kpis.xlsx and spot-checked redaction; format looks good.

Updated plan (confirmed):
- Redwood to run eval on received prompt set and sanitized logs; deliverables: token-level latency distributions, per-task F1/precision/recall where applicable, generation-quality examples + human-rated scores on a 1-5 scale.
- Success criteria we will compute against your KPI sheet; we'll flag any mismatches where the expected_output mapping is ambiguous.
- Timeline: Eval started today 2027-05-11; draft results by 2027-05-17; review/demo 2027-05-20.
- Owners: Marissa leads the eval, Aditya will enable instrumentation and confirm cost model, Rachel will QA prompt edge-cases. Please confirm if Priya is the product owner for demo feedback.

Security/upload: The Drive link is fine for now; if you require SFTP or an encrypted transfer, Priya, please advise and we'll escalate to security.

Next asks from Redwood:
1) Confirm Priya as PO for feedback (reply-all).
2) If there are any additional labeled examples for generation tasks (human ratings), please include — they help calibrate our automatic metrics.
3) Confirm any non-standard redaction we should be aware of.

We'll share a short summary report and a folder with raw metrics once the run completes. Schedule-wise I'll send a calendar invite for the 2027-05-20 demo (30m).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: prompt_samples.csv, data_privacy_notes.pdf
